pages.title: Quantum Singularity
pages.text: Every possible state of every quantum system, in superposition and compressed to one point. It is not in any definite state, and looking at it seems to collapse it differently each time. It flickers between being there and not.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I compressed the wavefunction, superpositions, entangled pairs, wave packets, spinors and fields together. Every possible outcome fell into the same point without any of them being chosen.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Spacetime Bearing, Theory of Everything.
